    About the data

    The 2025–26 edition: each company’s latest reported fiscal year, with market values at the close on Nov 20, 2026. Value created is measured as market value, which counts only what owners keep; workers, owners, taxes, research and platforms are separate lenses, never added to market value or to each other. The one combined measure is paid out & sales enabled, which adds up what a company paid others; it never adds pay on top. Pay is each company’s reported staff costs, or its median pay × people employed where only that is disclosed. Every profile shows each figure’s source and the line it came from.
